summary: Explore, care, and learn amazing things with Bubbu and Mimmi!
description:
🐱 Welcome to Bubbu & Mimmi World: The Virtual Pet Adventure!

Step into the joyful world of Bubbu the Cat, the global favorite virtual pet, and his playful kitten friend, Mimmi! Bubbu & Mimmi World is an engaging and creative pet game designed for children who love to explore, create, and care for animals. This is more than just a cat game; it’s an exciting universe of discovery, fun, and friendship. Enjoy this amazing kids game now and start your endless adventure!

🐾 Pet Care and Learning
• Be the Caretaker: Your virtual companions (dogs, cats, rabbits, and bears) rely on your love and attention. Meet their daily needs to keep them happy and healthy.
• Responsibility & Empathy: Caring for your virtual pet is a playful way to develop responsibility, empathy, and important life skills.

🎨 Dress-up, Create & Celebrate 
• Personal Style: Customize your character with hundreds of outfits, hairstyles, makeup options, and accessories. Express your unique style! 
• K-Pop Superstar Makeover: Create your own K-Pop idol cats! Dress them in trendy stage wear, try vibrant new looks, and watch them perform fun dance moves! 
• The Magical Wedding Day: Become a top wedding planner. Design dream rings, style the bride and groom, and throw an unforgettable celebration. 
• New Friends: Hatch mysterious eggs to discover adorable pets. Combine them to create even more lovable creatures and expand your joyful pet family.

🗺️ Explore an Expansive World
• Unlimited Exploration: Wander from magical castles to enchanted forests, from bustling city centers to sparkling seas. Every corner of Bubbu & Mimmi’s world is packed with surprises and adventures.
• Role-Play Fun: Dive into daily life by visiting the Supermarket, getting pampered at the Spa, enjoying a makeover at the Beauty Salon and Hair Salon, or throwing unforgettable birthday parties! You can also lend a hand at the Hospital and learn to care for injured friends. 

🎮 Engaging Mini-Games & Activities
Enjoy endless fun with a collection of exciting mini-games and daily surprises:
• Puzzles: Test your skills with the block puzzle game.
• Adventure: Explore Candyland through fun mini-game.
• Arcade: Try catching items on the beach.
• Classics: Play a relaxing game of Solitaire.
• Daily Surprises: Collect daily gifts and enjoy constantly fresh content that keeps the adventure going!

❤️ A Trusted and Safe Experience
At Bubadu, we are committed to creating games for children that spark creativity, friendship, and positive learning. Bubbu & Mimmi World is designed as a safe, family-friendly space where players can develop imagination and emotional growth. It is an ideal game—intuitive and packed with creative possibilities.

⚠️ Important Information for Parents
This game is free to play, but some in-game items and features may require real-money purchases. Please check your device settings for in-app purchase controls.
• Subscription Details: Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Google Play account settings.
• Advertising: The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties, which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.

🔒 Safety and Privacy (COPPA Certified)
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO.
• Privacy Policy: If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy, please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml.
• Terms of Service: https://bubadu.com/tos.shtml
